title: Constantinople to Istanbul: One City, Two Empires
summary: Major V&A exhibition tracing the city through its Byzantine and Ottoman eras, in Galleries 38 and 39.

title: Canan Tolon: Too early too late
summary: Solo exhibition of the Istanbul-born artist Canan Tolon. Open Tuesday to Saturday.

title: Revisiting Yassıada: Recent Research on an Early Byzantine Shipwreck
summary: Anglo-Turkish Society online talk by Prof. Justin Leidwanger on the Yassıada wreck and its maritime world.

title: The Crimean Memorial Church in Constantinople: from Competition to Completion
summary: Victorian Society online talk by Neil Jackson on the Anglican church in Istanbul's Beyoğlu.

title: Of Trojans and Turks: the politics of retelling a myth
summary: Naoíse Mac Sweeney at the LSE Contemporary Turkish Studies programme.

title: The Uses of Oppression: Greek Newspapers in the Ottoman Empire 1830–62
summary: Hybrid talk by Marina Sakali with Dr Şükrü Ilıcak, a joint event of the Anglo-Turkish Society and the Hellenic Centre.

title: Turkish Night: Live Music & Meyhane Vibes
summary: Live Turkish music with singer Ezgi Telci and guitarist Burak Keleş. Table booking recommended.

title: Edis: UK & Europe Tour 2026
summary: Turkish pop star Edis plays London on his UK and Europe tour.

title: Tan Taşçı live in London
summary: Turkish singer Tan Taşçı in concert at indigo at The O2. Tickets via AXS.

title: Kazel Expo London: Food, Fashion, Music
summary: Touring Turkish festival of food, fashion and music, reported by Avrupa Gazete. Not yet on ExCeL's own calendar, so check before travelling.

title: Kardeş Türküler sing Ahmet Kaya
summary: Kardeş Türküler perform the songs of Ahmet Kaya. Tickets via Ticketmaster.

title: BLOK3: Global Arena Tour
summary: Turkish rap and trap artist BLOK3 headlines the O2 Arena. Presented by Rare Emotion; tickets mostly via AXS.

title: Birsen Tezer live in London
summary: Turkish singer-songwriter Birsen Tezer plays jazz, folk and alternative pop with her band, with support from Sevtap Işık.

title: Yılmaz Vural ile Maç Günü Kahvaltısı
summary: Matchday breakfast with Yılmaz Vural, run by the London Fenerbahçe supporters' association, to watch Shakhtar Donetsk v Fenerbahçe. Register via fenerbahcelondon.co.uk.

title: Turkish Apparel/RTW Sourcing Meetings London 2026
summary: Sourcing meetings connecting UK buyers with Turkish apparel and ready-to-wear manufacturers.

title: Ferman Akgül live in London
summary: maNga frontman Ferman Akgül plays his hits on his UK & Ireland tour.

title: Fazıl Say Jazz Quintet
address: Barbican Centre, Silk Street, London EC2Y 8DS
summary: Pianist Fazıl Say and his jazz quintet play new works and jazz arrangements of his classical pieces.

title: Murat Dalkılıç live in London
summary: Turkish pop singer Murat Dalkılıç plays a live show at indigo at The O2. Tickets are sold by AXS.

title: Gülsün Karamustafa: Remains of a Forgotten Promise
summary: First major UK solo exhibition of Turkish artist Gülsün Karamustafa, spanning five decades of work on memory, migration and the unfulfilled promises of authority. Open Tue–Fri 11am–6pm, Sat 12–6pm.

title: Researching the Middle East in the British and Ottoman Archives: Approaches and Challenges
summary: Panel with Dr Ali Açıkgöz, Dr Orçun Can Okan and Dr Hande Yalnızoğlu Altınay on using British and Ottoman archives to study Türkiye and the Middle East, chaired by Prof Yaprak Gürsoy. In person and online.

title: A Fusion of Sounds: Knightsbridge
summary: Social night with live vocals, violin, percussion and a DJ set, run in English and Turkish. Tickets from £15.
